comment: codex-cli 0.144.5's npm layout starts through a node shim (bin/codex.js) that runs the native binary from the platform package's vendor/<triple>/ directory, so the profile grants the exact @openai/codex package root (never the whole global npm prefix) and the node executable the shim's #!/usr/bin/env node resolves to. Codex's own bubblewrap sandbox cannot run inside a Landlock domain, so a contained codex runs only at the rung that bypasses it.

login.reason: codex login --device-auth prints a URL and a one-time code to enter there, then polls until the person has signed in: no localhost callback, which --contain-restrict-tcp would block. The login is stored in CODEX_HOME/auth.json; codex login status reports it.
